{{Episode list
| EpisodeNumber   = 13
| EpisodeNumber2  = 13
| Title           = Octonauts and the Lost Sea Star
| Aux2            = Kwazii
| OriginalAirDate = {{start date|2010|10|20|df=y}}
| AltDate         = 28 May 2011
| ShortSummary    = A [[sea star]] named Twinkle has got lost on the beach, but the Octonauts have to search the sea from top to bottom to find her home, as there are nearly 2,000 species of sea star living at all levels of the ocean. On a [[Coral reef|reef]] in the [[Photic zone|Sunlight Zone]], they encounter a [[sunflower sea star]] and a predatory [[long-spine porcupinefish]]. In the [[Mesopelagic zone|Twilight Zone]] they encounter [[brittle star]]s and get chased into a cave by a [[wolf eel]], where they notice Twinkle [[Bioluminescence|glows in the dark]], which means she is from the [[Bathypelagic zone|Midnight Zone]]. They end up crashing the Gup at the bottom of an [[oceanic trench]], but luminous sea stars light the way out for them.
| LineColor       = 3aaab8
}}

=== Series 2 (2012–13) ===
A second series of 22 episodes started on 19 November 2012 on the UK's CBeebies channel, but was halted with no explanation after 10 episodes, leading to criticism from viewers. Broadcasts resumed in March 2013, but stopped a week later (with the last 7 episodes still unaired). 5 of the remaining episodes were released in May 2013 and then the last 2 episodes were released in September 2013, just before the broadcast of series 3.

Written by: [[Ken Pontac]], [[Rich Fogel]], [[Jimmy Hibbert]], Dean Stefan, [[Adam Peltzman]], Billy Aronson, [[Danny Stack]], Cydne Clark, Carin Greenberg, Allan Neuwirth, Nicky Phelan, [[Martha Speaks (TV series)|Raye Lankford]], Gabe Pulliam, Adam Idelson, Sam Dransfield, Davey Moore, and Steve Clark

=== Series 5 (2023–27) ===
A fifth series of 27 episodes started being broadcast on CBeebies on 27 March 2023. All other episodes were released in Chinese only before debuting in September 2026 on Amazon Prime Video.

== Specials ==
The specials are double-length episodes that are first broadcast during the [[Christmas]], [[New Year]], or [[Memorial Day]] periods before being repeated alongside regular episodes.
{{Episode table |background=00FFFF |overall= |title= |aux2= |aux2T= Octo-Alert sounded by |airdate= |episodes=
{{Episode list
| EpisodeNumber   = 1
| Title           = Octonauts and the Great Penguin Race
| Aux2            = Kwazii
| OriginalAirDate = {{start date|2010|12|13|df=y}}
| ShortSummary    = Peso is going home to [[Antarctica]] to watch an annual penguin [[triathlon]], the Iron Clam Competition, but learns to his dismay that his little brother Pinto has entered him in it. With the Octonauts cheering him on, Peso will have to [[Sliding (motion)|slide]], [[Diving (sport)|dive]] and [[Swimming|swim]] his way to victory, against the annual athletic winner, Hugo.
| LineColor       = 00FFFF
}}
{{Episode list
| EpisodeNumber   = 2
| Title           = Octonauts and the Great Christmas Rescue
| Aux2            = Inkling
| OriginalAirDate = {{start date|2011|12|1|df=y}}
| ShortSummary    = The Octonauts travel for Christmas to Professor Inkling's childhood home, a [[seamount]], but soon get involved in a rescue mission when a [[rockslide]] endangers a rare 500-year-old [[Hawaiian gold coral|golden coral]] and traps Professor Inkling's [[Niece and nephew|nephew]] Squirt. They also learn about [[Spirobranchus giganteus|Christmas tree worm]]s which live in holes in rocks. Crucial to completing the mission is the new heavy-duty vehicle GUP-X which Tweak has built as an early [[Gift|present]] for Captain Barnacles.
| LineColor       = 00FFFF
}}
{{Episode list
| EpisodeNumber   = 3
| Title           = Octonauts and the Amazon Adventure
| Aux2            = Kwazii
| OriginalAirDate = {{start date|2013|1|1|df=y}}
| ShortSummary    = Kwazii enters a shipwreck to get Calico Jack's map to an underwater [[El Dorado|city of gold]]. This leads the Octonauts up the [[Amazon River]], past parrots, [[Potamotrygonidae|freshwater stingray]]s, [[black caiman|caiman]] and [[Amazonian manatee|manatee]]s. But a falling tree traps the GUP-A, and a [[tidal bore]] comes up the river, scattering the Octonauts. Captain Barnacles looks for the others with the aid of a [[Amazon river dolphin|river dolphin]] and her [[Animal echolocation|echolocation]] abilities. The Octonauts help an [[electric eel]], a stranded [[arapaima]], and get chased by [[piranha]]s. But a [[panaque]] frees the trapped GUP-A. Meanwhile, Kwazii has been saved by Calico Jack who turns out to be alive but lost his ship after an attack by [[fire ant]]s and an [[anaconda]]. His incomplete map had led him in circles, but Kwazii's piece completes it so they can finish the quest. After being blocked by hostile [[capybara]]s, they are reunited with the others in time to fight off more anacondas. Finally, the "city of gold" turns out to be a colony of golden [[Spongillida|freshwater sponge]]s in the bottom of a pool.
| LineColor       = 00FFFF
}}
{{Episode list
| EpisodeNumber   = 4
| Title           = Octonauts and the Mariana Trench Adventure
| Aux2            = Barnacles
| OriginalAirDate = {{start date|2013|5|27|df=y}}
| ShortSummary    = The Octonauts assemble Tweak's new Deep Sea Octolab and lower it to the deepest part of the ocean, the [[Mariana Trench]], where Shellington and Dashi intend to study the sea life. Whilst the Octonauts are setting up the base it is invaded by some [[giant isopod]]s and other creatures which are looking for a new [[hydrothermal vent]] to live around (and accidentally knocking out the power source in the process). They also observe some [[sea cucumber]]s and luminous [[sea star]]s, and whilst chasing the Octobots and the Vegebot after a power surge causes them to go out of control, Kwazii has to avoid undersea [[mud volcano]]es which have created a lake of hot mud on the seafloor and lava.
| LineColor       = 00FFFF
}}

| LineColor       = 00FFFF

{{Episode list
| EpisodeNumber   = 6
| Title           = Octonauts and the Over, Under Adventure
| Aux2            = Shellington
| OriginalAirDate = {{start date|2014|3|14|df=y}}
| ShortSummary    = The Octonauts' mission to explore [[Antarctica]] during which they marvel at [[sea tulip]]s and [[hourglass dolphin]]s becomes a desperate rescue as a group of [[sea star]]s and [[Sea urchin|urchin]]s are threatened by a [[brinicle]] - a rare underwater icicle that can freeze creatures on the sea bed. So the crew use the recently built GUP-S to save the day, with the help of a [[Weddell seal]].
| LineColor       = 00FFFF
